msg: Hi, I'm an American who has lived in Cartagena for two years (I have my cédula de extranjería). I organize a team outing for 7 colleagues, all certified divers, most certified recently. We'd leave from Cartagena on a Saturday. What do you recommend?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great team outing! For a Saturday trip from Cartagena, I’d recommend the *Fun Dives — 2 dives*: it’s a same-day round trip to the Rosario Islands, with guided reef dives, equipment, boat transfer, and lunch included.

It can be combined with the 10% online discount. Most of your colleagues are recently certified, so they can join as long as they bring their certification cards. If anyone has gone more than two years without diving, a refresher is normally required.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 630.000 COP · 700.000 COP

*Group discount (5 people or more):* an extra 10%, on top of the 10% online discount (20% total when booking online). It isn't automatic: ask the team before paying, or it's lost. It doesn't apply to PADI courses.

Since you're already a certified diver, I'd suggest the *2-dive trip* in the Rosario Islands; for more days there are *multi-dive packages*, and to level up, the *Advanced course* or a specialty. Which one interests you? 🤿

msg: So 8 of us in total, including me. Thinking about it, some colleagues would like to stay over and dive Sunday too. Is there a two-day option, and how does the group discount work for the 8 of us?
reply:
Yes—there’s a *2-day package with 4 daytime dives*. You’d leave Cartagena on Saturday, stay overnight on the islands (accommodation isn’t included), dive twice each day, and return to Cartagena on Sunday. Lunch is included on day 1 only.

It must be requested from the team *before paying*; it isn’t automatic and can’t be applied retroactively. Since you’re a Colombian resident, the booking is handled in COP at the online price; there’s no separate discount for being Colombian.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 630.000 COP · 700.000 COP
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP
• 5 Dives - 2 days: 1.429.000 COP · 1.587.000 COP

*Group discount (5 people or more):* an extra 10%, on top of the 10% online discount (20% total when booking online). It isn't automatic: ask the team before paying, or it's lost. It doesn't apply to PADI courses.

For those days I suggest the *4-dive* package. If you'd like more, there is a *5-dive* one with a night dive, or separate one-day trips; just tell me.

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: No, everyone dived within the last year. Good, then the 4-dive package for all 8. I'll need to request the group discount before paying, so could you connect me with someone to arrange it? Hotel on the island we'll sort ourselves.
reply:
Perfect—the 4-dive package is a great fit for all 8 of you. It includes 4 daytime dives over 2 days, boat transport from Cartagena, equipment, and lunch on day 1. You’ll need to arrange one night’s accommodation on the islands separately.

The 10% group discount applies to groups of 5 or more and stacks with the 10% online discount (20% total when booking online). It must be requested before payment and isn’t applied automatically. It applies to recreational diving, but the group discount and own-equipment discount don’t stack with each other. Since you’re a Colombian resident, the booking is handled in COP at the online price; there’s no separate discount for being Colombian. I can connect you with a team advisor to arrange the group discount.

This needs to be checked by a person from our team, who can see bookings, payments and emails. I'm passing you to a Diving Planet advisor now and they'll get in touch with you shortly. Thanks! 🙌

msg: Great, thanks. I'll wait for their message.
reply: Noted 🙌 I've already passed your case to an advisor from the team: they can see this whole conversation and will write to you here shortly.
